sonnet.problem: Papa Dorin says 'That's a different John, friend, not John the Baptist.' The passage never says this, so it is a Bible fact from outside the passage, and it carries no reference.
sonnet.rule: Every Bible fact he states carries its reference.

sonnet.problem: The question says 'they will all see heaven open,' but no earlier card says who 'they' are. Card 14 has Jesus speaking to 'him,' and the BSB has Jesus say 'you will all see.' The baker can't tell who 'they' points to.
sonnet.rule: 'He,' 'she' and 'they' always point to someone the baker can tell.
